::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 2 Samuel chronicles David's reign, revealing both his greatest triumphs and deepest failures. The book demonstrates God's covenant faithfulness despite human weakness and points toward the coming eternal King. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
2 Samuel 1:26
Wonderful was thy love to me
### Why This Verse David's lament for Jonathan ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's response to the deaths of Saul and Jonathan. The key verse highlights David's honor, grief, and respect for God's anointed. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
2 Samuel 2:1
Shall I go up?
### Why This Verse David seeks God's guidance ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's rise as king of Judah. The key verse emphasizes seeking God's guidance before taking action. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
2 Samuel 3:39
The LORD reward the evildoer
### Why This Verse David's response to Abner's death ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the struggle between the houses of Saul and David. The key verse highlights God's steady fulfillment of His promise to David. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
2 Samuel 4:4
Mephibosheth was lame
### Why This Verse Important introduction ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the murder of Ish-bosheth. The key verse demonstrates David's commitment to justice despite personal advantage. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
2 Samuel 5:10
The LORD God of hosts was with him
### Why This Verse Summary of David's rise ### Chapter Insight This chapter marks David's coronation over all Israel and the capture of Jerusalem. The key verse emphasizes that David's success came from God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
2 Samuel 6:14
David danced before the LORD
### Why This Verse Famous worship passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the return of the ark to Jerusalem. The key verse highlights joyful worship and reverence for God's holiness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
2 Samuel 7:16
Thy kingdom shall be established forever
### Why This Verse Davidic Covenant centerpiece ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's covenant with David. The key verse promises an enduring kingdom and points forward to the Messiah. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
2 Samuel 8:15
David executed justice and righteousness
### Why This Verse Summary of David's reign ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes David's military victories and administration. The key verse emphasizes that the Lord gave David victory wherever he went. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
2 Samuel 9:7
I will show thee kindness
### Why This Verse David's grace to Mephibosheth ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's kindness to Mephibosheth. The key verse illustrates covenant faithfulness and undeserved grace. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
2 Samuel 10:12
Be of good courage
### Why This Verse Joab's exhortation ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's war with Ammon and Syria. The key verse calls God's people to courage while trusting Him for the outcome. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
2 Samuel 11:27
The thing David had done displeased the LORD
### Why This Verse Judgment on David's sin ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts David's sin with Bathsheba. The key verse marks the beginning of a tragic season caused by moral failure. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
2 Samuel 12:7
Thou art the man
### Why This Verse Nathan confronts David ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Nathan's confrontation and David's repentance. The key verse reveals the seriousness of sin while pointing to God's mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
2 Samuel 13:22
Absalom hated Amnon
### Why This Verse Beginning of family tragedy ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Amnon's sin against Tamar and Absalom's revenge. The key verse demonstrates the devastating consequences of unchecked sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
2 Samuel 14:14
God devises means to bring back the banished
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted mercy verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Absalom's return to Jerusalem. The key verse highlights the tension between justice and reconciliation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
2 Samuel 15:26
Let Him do to me as seems good
### Why This Verse David's submission ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Absalom's rebellion against David. The key verse reveals David's humility and trust in God's sovereignty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
2 Samuel 16:12
The LORD may look upon my affliction
### Why This Verse David's humility ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's flight and the responses of various individuals. The key verse demonstrates David's willingness to submit to God's discipline. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
2 Samuel 17:14
The LORD had appointed to defeat Ahithophel's counsel
### Why This Verse Divine providence ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the competing counsel given to Absalom. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign overruling of human plans. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
2 Samuel 18:33
O my son Absalom
### Why This Verse One of the Bible's most famous laments ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Absalom's death and David's grief. The key verse reveals the heart of a father despite betrayal. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
2 Samuel 19:14
He bowed the hearts of Judah
### Why This Verse Restoration of David ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's restoration to the throne. The key verse highlights the challenge of reconciliation after conflict. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
2 Samuel 20:22
So he blew a trumpet
### Why This Verse End of Sheba's rebellion ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Sheba's rebellion. The key verse emphasizes the ongoing need for unity under godly leadership. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
2 Samuel 21:1
There was a famine three years
### Why This Verse Covenant accountability ### Chapter Insight This chapter records acts of justice and victories over Israel's enemies. The key verse highlights covenant faithfulness and divine justice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
2 Samuel 22:31
As for God, His way is perfect
### Why This Verse Classic statement of trust ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains David's song of deliverance. The key verse celebrates God as the source of strength, protection, and salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
2 Samuel 23:3
He that rules must be just
### Why This Verse David's last words ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's final words and honors his mighty men. The key verse reflects the ideal of righteous leadership under God's authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
2 Samuel 24:2
Number the people
### Why This Verse Beginning of David's census account ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts David's census and its consequences. The key verse demonstrates David's trust in God's mercy even amid judgment. :::
